newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: CGE UNIT TAKES MAJORITY IN DUTCH FIRM.
newsitem.headline: CGE UNIT TAKES MAJORITY IN DUTCH FIRM.

text.p: Small Dutch Rail company Lovers Rail said on Friday CGEA, a unit of France's Compagnie Generale des Eaux, had taken an undisclosed majority in Lovers Rail.

"They (CGEA) do have a majority but the other two owners have a substantial part of the shares. Also in the agreement the management has to make decisions unanimously," said Peter Sul of Peter Sul Beheer BV.

His company and canal boat company Rederij Lovers BV -- the joint owners of Lovers Rail Beheer BV -- had been in talks with the French company for several months said Sul, who is also managing director of Lovers Rail Beheer BV.
"We've come to an agreement where CGEA is willing to invest in rolling stock and technical support," said Sul in a telephone interview, declining to give financial details.

Lovers Rail, set up by a canal boat cruise firm, last year began the first private rail service in the Netherlands, running a beach service between Amsterdam and the North Sea coast over a disused stretch of track.

Earlier this week the firm was awarded two routes for operation from mid-1998 between Leiden and the Hague and Utrecht and Hilversum - competing with state-owned Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS) for high-volume traffic.
"We expect more routes to come," said Sul on Friday, declining to disclose any of Lovers Rail's trading figures.
The Dutch government plans to open the Netherlands' railways system to competition ahead of privatisation of NS.

CGEA last year won a franchise to run most of southeast England's commuter train services into London in return for spending 400 mln stg on new trains. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
